dimensions.label: Road user
dimensions.description: Persons killed by their role in the crash.

categories.label: Drivers and riders
categories.description: Drivers of motor vehicles and riders of motorcycles, mopeds and bicycles.

dimensions.label: Mode of transport
dimensions.description: Persons killed by the vehicle they were using (pedestrians: none).

categories.label: Car occupants
categories.description: Drivers and passengers of passenger cars.

categories.label: Motorcyclists
categories.description: Riders and passengers of motorcycles of any engine size.

categories.label: Cyclists
categories.description: Riders of bicycles, including electrically assisted bicycles (e-bikes).

categories.label: Goods vehicles and tractors
categories.description: Occupants of vans, lorries, road tractors and agricultural tractors.

categories.label: Buses and coaches
categories.description: Occupants of buses, mini-buses, trolley buses and motor coaches.

categories.label: Pedestrians
categories.description: People not using a vehicle (Eurostat category 'Other').

categories.label: Other and unknown
categories.description: Quads, e-scooters and other micro-mobility, trams, other vehicles, riding animals, and unknown.

dimensions.label: Age group
dimensions.description: Persons killed by their age, in Eurostat's age bands.

dimensions.label: Type of road
dimensions.description: Persons killed by the type of road where the crash happened.

categories.label: Urban roads
categories.description: Roads inside an urban area, excluding motorways.

categories.label: Rural roads
categories.description: Roads outside urban areas, excluding motorways.

categories.label: Motorways
categories.description: Motorways, including the few inside urban areas.

categories.label: Unknown
categories.description: Neither the area nor the road type recorded.
